scope_note: Southern subtropical-gyre eastward component at 30 W; surface section is separate from the existing intermediate-depth float route. SAC/ACC and branch correspondence require independent review. Local monthly-mean component spans, not flow-normal widths, whole-current dimensions or a seasonal footprint.
layer: Satellite-derived near-surface product with nominal 15 m coordinate; not a direct 15 m instrument section or depth-resolved velocity.
time_convention: 72 nominal five-day 2013 archive samples, with four six-day gaps, January 1 through December 26. One year, not climatology or adequate evidence for annual extrema.
